patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Saleor share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than Saleor's shape. Choose Saleor only if your buying job matches “Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, En” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Workflow advantage: Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail; Saleor leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Saleor share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe; Saleor is Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, Enterprise quote. Forever Free is non-commercial onl.
- Company-size focus: Lightspeed Retail (small-business, mid-market) vs Saleor (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Saleor-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Saleor — Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO.

Limitations — Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live; Saleor: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Forever Free Cloud is non-commercial — not a production merchant free plan.

Poor-fit cases: Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · Saleor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO · Avoid Lightspeed Retail if you actually need Saleor's motion (Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
